items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: they were Louie Metcalf on trumpet, George Washington Charlie Weiser on trombone, Al Morgan on bass, Zootie Simmons on drums and Clarence Wheeler on trumpet.

ctx.x: Well, who was in the band with you?
Well, they were Louie Metcalf on trumpet, George Washington Charlie Weiser on trombone, Al Morgan on bass, Zootie Simmons on drums and Clarence Wheeler on trumpet.
